patch_description: This uses a regime-mixture portfolio instead of a mutation budget. It estimates stable, repair, and fragile ecological regimes, then blends operator logits from those regimes with evidence-weighted operator trust. Standard mutation is released mainly in a high-stress repair window with parent vigor and clone underperformance, while stable and fragile regimes collapse back toward clone/conservative protection. This should preserve injury-world gains without letting mutation leak into sham or weak-founder tails.
